narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to the city of Camden and nearby communities on the evening of June 14. Rainfall totals were around 2 to 3 inches.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Camden and in Pennsauken Township with numerous water rescues reported.
